title: Whole-request path SLI prober and regional failover dashboard buildout
creator: Priya Nair
description: We need a robust observability surface that attributes token-latency SLI violations to the full request path (ingress, routing, KV prefetch, decode, network) and surfaces regional failover behaviour in a single dashboard. Current dashboards show p95/p99 at a per-route level but don’t correlate admit/fanout decisions, cache hit impact, or graceful fallback events. This ticket adds a lightweight SLI prober that emits synthetic trace events at representative sequence lengths, implements derived telemetry to attribute latency deltas to pipeline stages, and builds a dashboard that helps on-call and SREs triage multi-region failover events and tune admission/circuit breaker thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: Synthetic SLI prober runs in staging and produces per-request path traces for three sequence-length cohorts (short, medium, long) with <1% overhead on staging ingress
Derived metrics for stage-level latency (ingress, routing, kv_prefetch, model_decode, postprocess) are available in metrics backend with labels: region, model_variant, route, seq_cohort

Dashboard contains: time-series of cohort p50/p95/p99 per stage, stacked waterfall showing contribution to end-to-end latency, failover event timeline with region-to-region traffic shifts, and admission/circuit state panels
Alerts: SLI burn rate rule for regional p99 > 2x baseline for 5m and one playbook link triggers; alert noise rate validated against synthetic and canary runs
Runbook updated with step-by-step triage flow and links to the dashboard, synthetic prober controls, and the rollback/cutover play
Performance: metric ingestion adds <2% cardinality growth in the target metrics cluster and dashboards render within 2s for 1-hour windows
implementation_plan: Design prober: choose sampling cadence (default 1% overall, stratified by seq_length cohort), create lightweight client that exercises representative prompt templates
Instrument code paths: add timing spans at ingress, router, kv_prefetch, generator.decode, and postprocess. Ensure spans propagate region and admission metadata (admit_score, docketed_model_variant)
Create derived aggregation job: transform spans into stage latency metrics and per-request waterfall breakdowns (store histograms + derived percentiles), tag with region and seq_cohort
Build Grafana dashboard: panels for cohort percentiles by stage, waterfall attribution stacked area, region failover timeline (traffic shift arrows), and admission/circuit breaker state panels
Add alerts and link to runbook: implement burn-rate and step-up rules; add quiet hours tuning to avoid pager noise during low-traffic maintenance windows
Canary rollout: run prober in staging (2 days), then run in canary region (1 day) with low sampling, escalate to global with throttled sampling if stable
queries_and_panels: Panel: cohort_p99_by_stage = histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(stage_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, stage, region, seq_cohort, route, model_variant))
Panel: waterfall_contribution = sum by(stage) (rate(stage_latency_sum[5m])) / sum(rate(request_latency_sum[5m])) -> convert to percent stacked area
Panel: region_traffic_shift = increase(requests_total{region=~".*"}[10m]) grouped and annotated with routing.config.version to detect sudden redistribution
Query: admission_vs_latency = topk(50, sum by(admit_bucket, seq_cohort)(rate(requests_total[5m]))), correlate admit_bucket with cohort p99
Diagnostic table: recent_failovers = topk(25, increase(failover_events_total[1h])) with columns: timestamp, from_region, to_region, impacted_routes
rollout_plan: Stage: deploy prober binary to staging ingress with sampling disabled by default; toggle on via runtime flag for a single team for initial validation
Canary: enable 0.2% sampling in canary-region (e.g., us-west-2) and validate metrics cardinality and dashboard panels for 24h
Global: expand to 1% stratified sampling across regions, monitor metrics cluster and alert churn for 72h
Mitigation: revert runtime flag or disable prober if ingestion spike > threshold or dashboards degrade beyond 2s render time
comments: 2026-03-01 Priya Nair: Ticket created after on-call postmortem — recurring p99 spikes coincided with region failovers but we couldn't attribute which stage increased latency. Proposal: synthetic path prober + per-stage derived metrics.
2026-03-03 Liam Chen: Spike analysis prototype completed; small test on staging shows kv_prefetch adds 20-30ms for long sequences during cache miss storms. Pushing instrumentation PR next.

2026-03-05 PR merged: instrumentation spans added (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/3412). Note: added admit_score label with 3 buckets (high/medium/low) to reduce cardinality. See notes in PR for label selection rationale.
2026-03-07 Observability team: prototype aggregation job for stage histograms submitted (observability/pull/789). We validated cardinality growth ~1.2% in staging cluster at 0.5% sampling.

2026-03-09 Design review (SRE + Platform): agreed on three seq_cohorts boundaries: <=64 tokens (short), 65-512 (medium), >512 (long). Also agreed to keep prober templates general natural-language prompts to exercise common decode paths.
2026-03-10 Liam Chen: Grafana draft uploaded, panels populated, minor UX feedback from on-call. Next steps: enable canary sampling and validate runbook steps during a controlled failover drill.
